name: CATT_benchmark_swept-cloud-16
description: A benchmark built around 16 swept point-cloud scenarios designed to evaluate model performance on 3D perception and scene-understanding tasks. It focuses on measuring robustness of object detection / segmentation and spatial reasoning from swept LiDAR/point-cloud inputs across varied environments. The dataset is intended for evaluating models used in robotics and autonomous perception pipelines.
reputation: A niche, domain-specific dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited community adoption outside 3D perception / robotics research groups.
